title: Research: 25-paper coupled-output sweep and catalytic consumer circuits
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Research guide:** [Read the construction assessment](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d94f60b3b603782fce40f1911b3b094847d0f45a/research/literature-coupled-synthesis/SYNTHESIS.md), including its [ranked next experiments and stopping rules](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d94f60b3b603782fce40f1911b3b094847d0f45a/research/literature-coupled-synthesis/SYNTHESIS.md#ranked-next-experiments-and-stopping-rules). The [25-paper technique-to-code map](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d94f60b3b603782fce40f1911b3b094847d0f45a/research/literature-coupled-synthesis/LITERATURE.md) records primary sources and access limits; [RESULT.json](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d94f60b3b603782fce40f1911b3b094847d0f45a/research/literature-coupled-synthesis/RESULT.json) contains the executable evidence. These links pin the submitted commit.

Encoded outputs cannot be passed through a main-only controller ADD by adding the whole encoded bank: that also changes logical helpers. This package turns techniques from 25 primary papers into executable interface probes and combines catalytic restoration, low-rank factorization and alternative-basis propagation into explicit coupled consumer circuits.

The main constructive result is a cross-chart junction `dst += H_t P H_s src`, restoring all 120 source originals. Its bill is **3,712 ADD, 16 SCALE, 960 signed monomial field maps, zero new owned fields and zero Gaussian calls**. The same-chart specialization uses 2,360 ADD and 480 maps. A retained thin-query wrapper checks 352 original/owned input columns, keeps its 112 H1 calls, and charges all COPY/CLEAR, 112 owned fields and inverse-child translations. Distinct free chart words remain distinct; no cross-stage commutation is assumed.

The package also supplies gauge-optimized variants of PR4935's existing involutive completion, a 112-coset/6,216-pair observer architecture screen, actual two-generation displacement action, and a ranked construction report. There are 25 paper-to-code mappings: 20 have primary method material, while five record/abstract-only entries are explicitly access-limited. These are scoped adaptations, not reproductions of 25 complete papers.

**No new κ is claimed.** At submission main newly selects conditional κ=0.003027288235 from PR5413. The package authenticates and reconstructs that complete price profile, including all 18 backward FULLs. Conditional restoration to H9 targets has one combined observer/extra-termination allowance of 901.134447… at saving 0.004, or 50.063024… H1-equivalents per FULL. A fresh 112-query observer loses. The 32-H1 allocation and 0.0033 first milestone are design budgets, not implemented suppliers. Full native placement, disjoint mode ownership, the endogenous observer, precision/volume/tape compiler and outer admission remain open.

## Research highlights and design implications

The assessment favors a **history-augmented coupled transducer with an endogenous paid observer**. Design around what the next real consumer needs, keep precisely versioned information that remains useful, and charge its eventual restoration. The verified consumer circuits make that shape concrete; obtaining the observation inside the native provider is the next construction problem.

- **Conditioning and consumer cost must be optimized together.** The balanced gauge `a=-4,b=3` reduces the mode-block squared Frobenius norm from **898 to 688** relative to PR4935's gauge; the continuous optimum is 674. A different gauge, `a=-12,b=1`, improves the finite scalar row-sum bound from **69 to 50** and has a division-free boundary circuit. The latter is not an all-width physical infinity-norm theorem, and switching the balanced junction to that gauge introduces a restoration factor of `1/12` in its current factorization. Choose the gauge using the actual compiler error metric and the installed consumer.
- **The two-generation witness points toward bounded history.** The physical stationary-transfer equation `W3 T = D1 W1` has projected residual rank **eight** at a nonzero address; the zero-address test falsely passes. Adjoining the next chart yields 16 independent witness columns, which is a finite rank statement rather than a 16-call Gaussian lower bound. The implemented displacement identity `D1 C1 - C3 D1 = [W3,D1 W1][Z3 D1;-Z1]` supplies a concrete alternative: generation-tagged state whose lifetime ends at a real paid contact.
- **Observation ownership and version are decisive.** The exit requires `b = Z Q Y` for the **current output Y**, preserved as a borrowed observation. Given that observation, the verified local exit costs eight H1 calls, 456 ADDs and 240 monomial maps. PR5388's 112 paid observations apply to independent forward-helper inputs, so they cannot simply be renamed as this Y observation. Its complete helper recoding, original inputs and return costs remain obligations.
- **The observer screen rules out a specific tempting architecture.** The 112 source columns occupy **112 distinct right monomial cosets**, excluding one common Gaussian after monomial preaggregation for this source. All 6,216 pair comparisons distinguish `rank_B(Ej^-1 Ei)=2` from `rank_B(Ei Ej^-1)=0`; reversing the cancellation order does not aggregate independent inputs. This does not exclude multilayer, two-sided or endogenous-observer constructions.
- **Recursive savings are extremely sensitive to precision.** Under the conditional supplied-observer profile, the observer and extra termination share the following allowance. The 0.004 cost cap uses directed exact integer-root enclosures; other entries are numerical sensitivity screens, not compiler theorems.

| Desired saving | Combined observer + extra termination cap, H1-equivalents/FULL | Uniform paid-precision factor ceiling |
|---|---:|---:|
| 0.0033 | 59.743 | 1.004572 |
| 0.004 | 50.063024… | 1.003840 |
| 0.006 | 22.567 | 1.001743 |
| 0.007 | 8.908 | 1.000691 |

A 1% paid-precision increase exceeds every listed ceiling. The proposed **32 H1-equivalents/FULL** joint allocation remains unimplemented; at the 0.0033 milestone it leaves numerical moment margin 499.380 but only a 1.002118 paid-precision ceiling. It fails the 0.006 and 0.007 screens. The selected ordinary BIT admission is still 0.0034, so reaching 0.004 also requires an ordinary-work/compiler improvement.

The assessment therefore deprioritizes inverse-only packages, stationary eight-mode rebasing, passive one-Gaussian decoding and uncharged approximate degenerations. In particular, the native cycle `ZW=14I` is non-nilpotent, so the literature's nilpotent similarity construction does not automatically transfer to this supplier. These scoped exclusions narrow the next experiment without asserting a universal barrier.

## Task and overlap

Explicit donor-requested 20–30-paper sweep, expanding `joint-query-controller`; the frozen card and scope change are recorded in TASK.json. Initial scientific base: `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority revision 7. Submission comparison: canonical promotion `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`.

Nearest dependencies are [PR4935](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4935), [PR5388](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5388), [PR5398](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5398), [PR5402](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5402), [PR5411](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5411), [PR5413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5413) and the prior [PR5415](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5415) transport check. Exact heads, original byte comparisons and publication-ancestor pins are in SOURCES.json/ORIGINS.json. The involutive completion and three-shear/transpose method are prior work, not newly claimed here. The native coupled provider is not assumed already to equal the proposed H encoding.

Refreshed overlap coverage: 306 open PRs and 4,702 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; sparse local and historical coverage is incomplete. See VALIDATION.md for scope and access limitations.

## Validation

Python 3.12.8 and 3.14.5, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B research/literature-coupled-synthesis/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/literature-coupled-synthesis/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/literature-coupled-synthesis
```

Normal and optimized scoped checks pass. The registered runner checks metadata/source pins and the scientific probes. Failure controls include wrong coupling coefficient, missing owned initialization or catalytic restoration, tableau-invisible global phase, the zero-address false positive, whole-bank ADD substituted for main-only ADD, and wrong observation owner/version. The current-profile 0.004 decisions use directed integer roots. The new signed-invoice preflight was also run: conditional ideal uniformly better, fresh-query decoder uniformly worse, and the unimplemented 32-H1 allocation inconclusive in general concave order.

Committed-byte, official 32-file export, and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay checks are recorded in VALIDATION.md. Full selected/native admission, historical suites, Lean, Docker and optional full-history ancestry audit were not rerun. Hosted CI is separate from local evidence.

## Open next questions

The [ranked construction assessment](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d94f60b3b603782fce40f1911b3b094847d0f45a/research/literature-coupled-synthesis/SYNTHESIS.md#ranked-next-experiments-and-stopping-rules) gives the proposed order and stopping rules:

1. **Fit the actual provider and paid history at the first backward FULL/thin-query cut.** Derive the complete 232-field X/Y/mode input/return map with disjoint original-mode ownership. Supply current-version `ZQY` while preserving or provably displacing the demanded `Q^-1 X` response. Charge history return within the single combined cap; stop if an essential read is unavailable or the required inequality fails.
2. **Close two generations with bounded history.** Use the displacement state, terminate it at the second actual contact, and check every original column, borrowed response and owned-zero return. This establishes whether the first junction can be reused.
3. **Optimize the installed junction and both endpoints.** Start from the verified `H_t P H_s` and retained-query circuits, share work only where actual ownership permits, and choose the gauge for the real precision metric. Ordinary synthesis gains alone do not establish recursive savings.
4. **Compile and independently admit a favorable complete invoice.** After the paid bill passes, prove precision, volume, storage, tape and ordinary/outer admission. Retain the earlier no-IDLE, two-FULL, volume and independent-error obstructions within their stated scopes.

The structured questions are also recorded in [TASK.json](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d94f60b3b603782fce40f1911b3b094847d0f45a/research/literature-coupled-synthesis/TASK.json). The local consumer circuits do not themselves complete the native supplier or establish a new κ.
